node.descriptionHtml:
Searched the space. Found himself.

Every idea is a point in space. A similarity search returns the points closest to the one you asked about.

The ape set up a telescope and queried the whole sky. The nearest match came back in the same A-OK cap and the same headphones. Mouth open. Distance: zero.

The Similarity Search Tee puts our Apes on Keys operator at a tripod telescope, back to the viewer, in a red hoodie, looking into a field of red and black points. Up in the sky, the dots connect into a constellation of his own face. It is the closest result. It is not the answer anyone was looking for.

For anyone who has run a nearest-neighbor query and gotten back exactly what they put in.

Top result: you. A-OK.

  • Single graphic about 11 inches wide, centered on the chest.
  • Red, black and cream artwork with A-OK and Apes on Keys details.
  • Printed on the Bella + Canvas 3001 Unisex Staple T-Shirt.
  • Catalog colorways: Yellow, Black and White.

node.title: A-OK Serverless Tee
node.description: Serverless still has a server. SERVERLESS lifts the lid off the cloud to show the ape inside, sitting on a stool and hand-cranking the box that answers your request. An exploded-view print with numbered callouts on a Bella + Canvas 3001 tee.
node.descriptionHtml:
No servers in sight. One ape inside.

Serverless, we were told, means no servers.

We took the lid off the cloud anyway.

The Serverless Tee is an exploded-view diagram with four numbered callouts: 1, the cloud. 2, our Apes on Keys operator in a red hoodie and A-OK cap. 3, the crank. 4, the server. The ape sits on a small stool with headphones on and one hand on the handle. The expression is that of someone who has just been told the architecture is fully managed.

For anyone who has had to explain that there is still a server. It's just somebody else's ape.

Fully managed. Hand-cranked. A-OK.

  • Exploded-view cloud graphic with numbered callouts, about 11 inches wide, centered on the chest.
  • Cream, red and black artwork with halftone shading and A-OK and Apes on Keys details.
  • Printed on the Bella + Canvas 3001 Unisex Staple T-Shirt.
  • Colors: Red, Blue, Green and Black.

node.title: A-OK Virtual Machine Tee
node.description: Agents run on virtual machines inside other machines. Our ape at a beige CRT turns around, mouth open, while the ape on its screen does the same, again and again. Printed on a white Bella + Canvas 3001 tee.
node.descriptionHtml:
A machine. In a machine. All the way down.

Agents get their own computers now. Usually virtual ones, running on other computers, which are often virtual too.

Our Apes on Keys operator sat down to check on its sandbox. The sandbox had an ape in it. That ape had a sandbox too.

The Virtual Machine Tee puts the operator at a beige CRT, hands on the keys, turned around with its mouth open. On the screen, the same ape at the same desk turns around too. So does the one on its screen. Nobody has found the host yet.

For whoever provisions the sandboxes and has stopped asking what is underneath.

Same ape. Every layer. A-OK.

  • Nested ape-at-a-monitor graphic, about 11 inches wide, centered on the chest.
  • Red, black and cream artwork with halftone shading and A-OK and Apes on Keys details.
  • Printed on the Bella + Canvas 3001 Unisex Staple T-Shirt.

node.title: A-OK Resharded Tee
node.description: An ape in an A-OK cap and red hoodie stands in a three-box magic cabinet, the middle box slid out of line and one hand still reaching out for requests. Resharding with zero downtime, on a Bella + Canvas 3001 tee.
node.descriptionHtml:
Split in three. Still serving.

We needed to move the middle of the ape without taking the ape offline.

So we used the cabinet.

The Resharded Tee stages a live migration as the oldest trick in the magic cabinet. Three stacked boxes. Cap, headphones and red hoodie up top. Sweatpants and sneakers at the bottom. The middle box, in red and black hazard stripes, has slid a full step out of line, and one red sleeve still reaches out of the side port, hand open, taking requests. The face says nobody ran the migration plan past the ape.

Zero downtime. Some discomfort. For anyone who has moved a live system and would rather not talk about it.

Three shards. One ape. A-OK.

  • Magic-cabinet ape graphic, about 11 inches wide, centered on the chest.
  • Bone, red and black spray-stencil artwork; the only lettering is A-OK on the cap.
  • Printed on a Bella + Canvas 3001 Unisex Staple T-Shirt.
  • Catalog colorways: Red, Yellow, Green and White.

node.description: Our Apes on Keys operator leans back from a black singularity as it pulls in the hoodie drawstrings. A torn-paper front print about 11 inches wide on the Bella + Canvas 3001 tee in Red, Yellow, Black or White.
node.descriptionHtml:
One point. Everything falls in.

Everyone has a date for when it arrives. Nobody agreed on what it would look like.

It looks like a black disc. It has started on the drawstrings.

The Singularity Tee puts our Apes on Keys operator right at the edge: leaning back, mouth open, hoodie stretching toward the dark. For once, that permanently stunned face is the correct reaction.

The singularity is coming. One of us is already standing very close to it.

Event horizon reached. Strings attached. A-OK.

node.title: A-OK Inpainting Tee
node.description: Somebody tore his street poster, so the ape picked up a brush and painted his own missing shoulder back in: a confident best guess, the way an image model fills a hole. Torn-poster graphic, about 11 inches wide, on a Bella + Canvas 3001 tee.
node.descriptionHtml:
Torn out. Filled in. Close enough.

Somebody ripped a strip off the poster.

The ape picked up a brush and painted his own shoulder back in.

The Inpainting Tee puts our Apes on Keys operator on a torn street poster, mid-repair. A-OK cap. Red headphones. Red hoodie. One hand on the brush, filling the missing region with rough red strokes that are confident, plausible and not quite the original. No reference. Just a best guess that passes from across the street, which is how an image model fills a hole too.

He looks as surprised by the result as anyone.

Missing pixels. Reasonable guess. A-OK.

node.description: The Apes on Keys ape stands stunned in front of his own red-string wall: five pinned cards, all linked, none checked. Red, black and cream print about 11 inches wide on a Bella + Canvas 3001 tee in Red, Black or Navy.
node.descriptionHtml:
Everything connected. Nothing verified.

We asked for a knowledge graph.

The ape got out the red string.

The Knowledge Graph Tee puts our Apes on Keys operator in front of the finished work: five pinned cards (a gear, a cloud, a question mark, a lightbulb and his own red cap), all linked by red string. He is still holding one end of it. Mouth open. Every node pinned. Every edge red string. Zero sources.

A schema for people who see the connection first and go looking for the citation later.

Fully linked. Lightly sourced. A-OK.
